images.name: cnpg-postgres
images.summary: CloudNativePG-compatible PostgreSQL, built from PGDG source by melange.
images.description: PostgreSQL built from the PGDG source tarball by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for CloudNativePG clusters, with a sha-pinned ClusterImageCatalog.

images.name: bitnami-postgres
images.summary: Bitnami-compatible PostgreSQL 15-18: PGDG source in the /opt layout, sha-pinned Bitnami scripts, melange + apko on Wolfi.
images.description: PostgreSQL built from the PGDG source tarball by melange into the Bitnami OSS layout (/opt/bitnami/postgresql) with the sha-pinned legacy bitnami/containers script tree: entrypoint/setup contract, conf.default, initdb.d, uid 1001, pgaudit preload, repmgr compatibility package.

images.name: cloudnative-pg
images.summary: CloudNativePG operator manager, built from upstream source.
images.description: The CloudNativePG Kubernetes operator, compiled from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Scanned with grype, cosign-signed when clean.

images.name: cilium
images.summary: Cilium eBPF networking agent, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Cilium agent for eBPF-based Kubernetes networking, security and observability, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cilium-operator-generic
images.summary: Cilium operator for generic (non-cloud) clusters.
images.description: The cloud-agnostic Cilium operator that manages IPAM and cluster-wide state, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cilium-envoy
images.summary: Cilium's Envoy proxy build, pinned to the agent's release.
images.description: The Cilium Envoy proxy for L7 policy and ingress, following the pin in Cilium's own release. Built by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-controller
images.summary: cert-manager controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The cert-manager controller that issues and renews X.509 certificates in Kubernetes, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-cainjector
images.summary: cert-manager CA injector for webhooks and API services.
images.description: The cert-manager cainjector that injects CA bundles into webhooks and API services, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-webhook
images.summary: cert-manager admission webhook, built from upstream source.
images.description: The cert-manager admission webhook that validates and mutates cert-manager resources, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-controller
images.summary: MetalLB controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The MetalLB controller that assigns and reconciles LoadBalancer IP pools in Kubernetes, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-speaker
images.summary: MetalLB speaker, built from upstream source.
images.description: The MetalLB speaker that announces LoadBalancer IPs on the local network via Layer 2 or BGP, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-frr-k8s
images.summary: frr-k8s, MetalLB's FRR integration, built from upstream source.
images.description: frr-k8s, the FRR routing integration MetalLB's BGP backend runs on, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: helm-controller
images.summary: Flux helm-controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Flux controller that reconciles HelmReleases, installing and upgrading Helm charts in Kubernetes, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: kustomize-controller
images.summary: Flux kustomize-controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Flux controller that reconciles Kustomizations, rendering and applying Kustomize overlays to the cluster, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: notification-controller
images.summary: Flux notification-controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Flux controller that turns reconcile events into alerts (Slack, GitHub, Gatekeeper webhooks), built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: source-controller
images.summary: Flux source-controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Flux controller that produces artifacts from Git repositories, OCI registries and Helm repositories for the other controllers to consume, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: local-path-provisioner
images.summary: Rancher's local-path storage provisioner, built from upstream source.
images.description: Rancher's local-path-provisioner, the lightweight local-volume StorageClass provisioner, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: openbao
images.summary: OpenBao secrets manager, built from upstream source.
images.description: OpenBao, the open source secrets manager forked from Vault. The bao binary is built from upstream source by melange; the image is assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: dokuwiki
images.summary: DokuWiki plain-file wiki on Wolfi apache2 + mod_php.
images.description: DokuWiki, the plain-file wiki that needs no database, packaged from the pinned release tarball by melange and served by Wolfi apache2 with mod_php.

images.name: grafana-image-renderer
images.summary: Grafana's headless-browser panel renderer service.
images.description: Grafana Image Renderer v5, a static Go server driving headless Chromium to render panels to PNG and PDF. Built by melange, assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: homepage
images.summary: gethomepage dashboard, built from upstream source, served by Wolfi node.
images.description: Homepage, the self-hosted application dashboard for your services wall. The Next.js app is built from the pinned release tarball by melange and served by Wolfi nodejs on :3000 as nonroot, with config at /app/config.

images.name: gatus
images.summary: Gatus health monitor and status page, built from upstream source.
images.description: Gatus, a health monitor with a status page and prometheus metrics. The gatus binary is built from upstream source by melange; the image is assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: dozzle
images.summary: Dozzle real-time container log UI, built from upstream source.
images.description: Dozzle, the lightweight web UI for container logs. The Go binary with its embedded frontend (bun-built, like upstream) is compiled from source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: os-shell
images.summary: Nonroot helper shell for init containers — a bitnami os-shell counterpart.
images.description: A tiny nonroot helper image with bash, curl, jq and yq for Kubernetes init containers, sidecars and one-off shell tasks, assembled by apko from Wolfi packages only.

images.name: k8s-sidecar
images.summary: kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar (Grafana dashboards sidecar) built from source; Wolfi’s package is stale.
images.description: The Grafana dashboard sidecar that syncs ConfigMaps/Secrets to files, built from the upstream release tarball into a self-contained venv and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for ghcr.io/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar: USER 65534, same entrypoint and CLI contract.

images.name: kubernetes-reflector
images.summary: EmberStack Reflector (secret/configmap mirroring) built from upstream source.
images.description: The Reflector controller that mirrors secrets and configmaps across namespaces, built from the upstream .NET release tarball by melange into a self-contained tree and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for docker.io/emberstack/kubernetes-reflector.

images.name: alpine-k8s
images.summary: kubectl/helm pipeline toolbox — an alpine/k8s counterpart on Wolfi.
images.description: The kubectl + helm + kustomize toolbox the minilab pipelines run, assembled by apko on Wolfi: helm built from upstream source by melange (pinned to the 3.x line — Wolfi's plain helm is helm 4), everything else signed Wolfi packages. Image version = kubectl version, mirroring the reference tag.

images.name: frr
images.summary: FRRouting BGP suite (zebra/bgpd/vtysh), built from upstream source.
images.description: The FRRouting protocol suite (zebra, bgpd, vtysh, watchfrr), built from the upstream release tarball by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for the quay.io/frrouting/frr BGP speaker used by Cilium and MetalLB.

images.name: traefik
images.summary: Traefik reverse proxy / ingress controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Traefik reverse proxy and Kubernetes ingress controller, compiled from the upstream release tarball by melange (static Go binary, upstream release ldflags) and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Dashboard UI assets not embedded; API and ping endpoints unaffected.

images.name: pocket-id
images.summary: Pocket ID passkey OIDC provider, built from upstream source.
images.description: Pocket ID, the simple OIDC provider that authenticates users with their passkeys. The Go binary — with the SvelteKit frontend embedded — is built from the upstream release tarball by melange; the image is assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: pocket-id-operator
images.summary: Pocket ID Kubernetes operator, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Pocket ID operator that reconciles instances, users, groups and OIDC clients from CRDs, compiled from the upstream release tarball by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Same /manager entrypoint and nonroot uid as upstream's image.
